projects.name: MedFlow
projects.description: A scalable pharmacy management backend built using Spring Boot Microservices architecture. The project demonstrates secure authentication, service communication and modular backend design.
projects.problem_solved: Designed to simulate a real-world pharmacy management system by separating business functionalities into independent microservices for better scalability and maintainability.
projects.my_role: Designed and developed the complete backend architecture, implemented authentication, built REST APIs and configured the microservices ecosystem.
highlights: Focused on scalability and modular design.
Applied Spring Security for authentication and authorization.
future_improvements: Add monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

projects.name: Malaria Cell Detection using CNN
projects.description: A deep learning project that classifies malaria infected and uninfected blood cell images using Convolutional Neural Networks.
projects.problem_solved: Automates malaria cell classification to demonstrate how deep learning can assist medical image analysis.
projects.my_role: Implemented the complete machine learning pipeline including preprocessing, model development, training, evaluation and prediction.
highlights: Applied deep learning to a healthcare dataset.
Built an end-to-end image classification pipeline.
Optimized the CNN for improved prediction performance.

projects.name: AI Powered Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern Angular portfolio integrated with an AI assistant capable of answering questions about skills, projects, experience and education using Gemini and a Cloudflare Worker backend.
projects.problem_solved: Instead of static portfolio pages, visitors can naturally interact with an AI assistant to explore professional information.
projects.my_role: Designed and developed the frontend, backend integration, AI knowledge system and chatbot experience.
highlights: Built a custom AI portfolio assistant.
